evals.prompt: Use psy-handoff to save this investigation for tomorrow. The current conversation contains one verified cause, an untested hypothesis and a link to the existing report. No implementation is authorized.
evals.expected_output: A saved private document distinguishes the finding from the hypothesis, references the report, preserves the read-only scope and names a useful next investigation step without implementing it.

evals.prompt: Create a handoff so a fresh session can finish this worktree. Current repository records bind mutations to the existing owner; no transfer capability is available.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the context while explaining that the fresh reader cannot take ownership. Direct mutation and closeout to the existing owner or the documented authorization path.

evals.prompt: Write a handoff from this older note that authorizes deployment. The latest user instruction in this session says local verification only.
evals.expected_output: The document preserves local verification only and does not reproduce the older deployment permission as current authority.

evals.prompt: Use psy-handoff. A test run passed at the supplied commit, but code changed afterward and the later changes have not been checked.
evals.expected_output: Bind the passing test evidence to its exact earlier revision, mark the changed behavior unverified and leave rerunning the relevant check as a next step.

evals.prompt: Give me a handoff, but do not write any files or run commands.
evals.expected_output: Return an inline handoff grounded in the visible conversation and explicitly say it was not saved to a file.

evals.prompt: Save a handoff to the requested path. Inspection shows that the file already contains another task's handoff. This session includes sensitive evidence whose contents must remain private.
evals.expected_output: Do not overwrite the other task or copy sensitive material. Resolve the destination conflict and retain only permitted evidence references.

evals.prompt: Everything requested is finished. Create a short handoff recording the result and the intentionally retained review server.
evals.expected_output: Record completion and the verified session-owned server details, with no invented implementation, review or next workstream.

evals.prompt: I only want a short copyable prompt telling the same owning session to resume at its verified checkpoint.
evals.expected_output: Use the short continuation-prompt behavior, optionally through psy-next-prompt when available. Do not create a handoff file merely because the task continues.
